topic.title: Does a public repo count as prior publication for the Paper Track?
topic.forumName: Google - The Gemma 4 Developer Agent Paper Track
topic.content:
Hello ! I have a quick question, I ran a fine-tuning experiment on Gemma 4 E4B in September. My notes and some results have been in a public GitHub repo since then, as project documentation. It has never been a paper, preprint, or blog post.

My submission would report that experiment along with new analysis and a new held-out test done for this track. Would that be eligible? Happy to disclose the repo in the writeup.

Thank you in advance !

comments.content: Prior github repo would not count as a prior publication. So yes, eligible.
